art_direction: A warm intimate medium shot of Pan Zi alone seated at his old wooden table in his modest rented room, eating from the blue-rimmed white bowl of noodles with bamboo chopsticks; half remains in the bowl. A pale enamel kettle stands nearby, soft amber daylight from the green-framed window. He has a relaxed ordinary expression, a small moment of daily life before the journey. Only Pan Zi is present; realistic hand holding chopsticks, no writing.
visible_description: 潘子在出租屋木桌前吃面，碗中尚余半碗。
poster_text: 潘子正吃着面，屋里还亮着暖灯。
source_chapter: 《盗墓笔记8》大结局第七十四章（二）
adaptation_note: 小三爷到门口叫人、出发前回望和离开路上的画面为基于用户叙述的虚构改编；潘子是否预感归期为吴邪的猜测。
